image_description: A close-up, studio-style shot of a white cloth diaper (nappy) against a plain white background. The diaper features a bulky, padded body with elasticized leg openings creating ruffles on the sides. The waistband area displays two distinct fastening tabs with a textured, possibly hook-and-loop or velcro-like appearance, bordered by yellowish stitching. The material appears to be a soft fabric rather than smooth plastic, suggesting a reusable cloth variant.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture on the fastening tabs is inconsistent and slightly 'mushy'. The parallel lines meant to represent the hook/loop mechanism lack sharp definition and seem to blend into the surrounding fabric border unnaturally. It looks like a low-resolution texture map rather than physical material.
The ruffling on the right side loses definition towards the bottom, appearing slightly melted or blurred into the white background. The edge continuity is weak compared to the sharper left side.

The object casts almost no discernible shadow on the white background, giving it a slight 'floating' appearance typical of cut-out AI generations, though the lighting on the object itself is coherent.
